note: Daily signal and position rows, one per R3 study, written by record.py under study/<id> on every run. inputs lists the recorder sources each prereg reads; gap_monitor fails if any of them, or the study row, is missing on a US business day from start on. status stays 'no position' until the study runs, and the row is still written daily. R3-03's T5YIE and T10YIE come from FRED, whose terms rule out a recorder, so the inputs are the Treasury nominal and real par curves they are built from.
